title: tap-iostat: Avoid the use of snprintf
description:
gcc has difficult telling that the magnitude can't actually exceed
certain values. Using g_strdup_printf avoids calling snprintf.

This avoid allocating some static buffers that receive intermediate
values and cause format-truncation warnings/errors.

Ping #20175
